##  About me 
Hello and welcome to my page!  

My name is Alex, a current Master of Data Science ("MDS") student at UBC.  

Prior to joining MDS, I completed a Bachelor's degree from UBC majoring in Economics and Statistics. I have also spent three and a half years at Deloitte Vancouver's Transfer Pricing practice where I helped multinational companies develop and defend pricing strategies for their intercompany transactions.  

In my free time, I enjoy playing soccer, snowboarding, and practicing latte art.

### 🔧 Skills
- **Languages**: Python, R, SQL
- **Data Science Libraries**: Pandas, Numpy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, XGBoost
- **Development & Deployment**: Git, Docker, AWS
